    Sign-preserving replay of hook and cohook arms #

    The boundary-square constructions replay endpoint suffixes after replacing the prefix word. The generic right-extension replay forgets that a hook tail is entirely negative or that a cohook tail is entirely positive. This file retains those signs; the resulting data can therefore be repackaged as literal maximal hooks and cohooks.
